Message.text: The foot of the Lattice Spire. It was a loom once, and the realm hung from it. The gate ahead knows the Great Sigils and will open for any two of the four.
A gate of woven light, shut. Two Great Sigils, any two: the gate does not take them, it only wants to see that you carry them. Bring them and press the word you know.
The outer ramp. The Lattice came unraveled here: the road has gaps no wider than a jump. Each gap has a ladder on its far wall for anyone who would rather climb.
The first floor. The things that kept the Verge and the lake are here, wearing the Lattice like armor. They are stronger than you remember.
The second floor. The Castle and the deep sent their best. A Flask Dew left on the west shelf, for whoever is still standing.
The third floor, the last before the roof. The cold from Rimeshelf followed the Lattice up here. The newest page waits on the east wall.
The Loom. One Lantern before the roof. The stair behind it climbs to a gate; beyond the gate the thread begins and ends.
